g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-412 Bench spindle capper (built in house) · rev B
SS 304 frame; UHMW nest; PC guard
No product contact (caps on): #4 brushed or bead blast; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: FRONT VIEW (1:3), CARRIAGE UP, JAR PHANTOM
Base weldment (base plate, column, gussets, top cap, clevis, rail seat bar)
Carriage weldment (plate, shelf, gussets, link lug), machined after welding
Controls kit (enclosure, E-stop, switch, lamp, fuse, cord)
TBL-1 top 914 [35.98] AFF; 4 x M8 through the bench top
shaker Ø66 [2.598] 53 mm cap; jar Ø86.4 [3.402] 89 mm cap
P1-401 fills; V-block S or J holes
53 mm: 1.6 N·m [14 lbf·in]; 89 mm: 2.5 N·m [22 lbf·in]
clutch setting, check on P1-402 hourly
shaker: rod top 251.2 [9.890]; jar: flip block in (299.9 [11.807])
1. Operator: container in the V-nest, close the toggle clamp (left hand), pull the lever (right hand). Release when the clutch slips (≈ 1/2 s); open the clamp.
2. Motor runs only when the carriage is below the top limit switch (21) and the E-stop is out; carriage rises by the gas spring when the lever is released.
3. Change S ↔ J: swap the chuck insert (3 set screws), move the V-block to the S or J holes (2 x M8), flip block in (jar) or out (shaker), set the clutch, test on P1-402.
4. No product contact: caps are on before the chuck touches them. Nest, V-block and pad are UHMW so they do not mark the containers.
5. All steel parts 304, #4 brushed; welds per P1-412-100 / 200. Hardware A2-70 unless noted (P1-412-800).
